reason: The spare circulator appears to give the sheltered potato bed a low-power way to move water, directly addressing the survival goal.
expectation: I expect the circulator to provide gentle water circulation for the potato trough, though I don't know whether it will also serve the lettuce.

alternatives.reason: The felt and hose might provide another low-power watering method, but the circulator's purpose seems clearer.
The lamp and foil seem useful for lighting the leaves, but I want to address root watering first.

effect: The pump gives the potato trough its own reserve-powered circulation, so the lettuce still needs a watering method.
reaction: The fit with the existing loop is satisfying, and the reminder that the roots still need air is useful.
reason: The capillary felt and hose may provide a low-power way to deliver water to the lettuce bed.
expectation: I expect them to make a wicking arrangement, though I do not yet know how it will connect to the trough.

alternatives.reason: The lamp and foil may help keep the leaves lit, but I want to finish arranging water first.

effect: The felt and hose made a wick intended to bridge the lettuce reservoir and root bed, so it still needs to be fitted to the trough.
reaction: The hose sleeve holding the felt without pinching it is a useful detail.
reason: Fitting the wick to the lettuce trough should give the second bed a low-power water supply.
expectation: I expect the wick to draw water from the lettuce reservoir into its shallow root bed without a pump.

alternatives.reason: The foil and lamp could address the lighting goal, but I want to finish the watering setup first.

effect: Both beds now have low-power watering, and the remaining goal is to light the leaves.
reaction: The explanation that the bed must remain drained reinforces why the wick is useful.
reason: The foil and lamp are the only available combination and seem suited to providing light.
expectation: I expect the foil to help direct the lamp's light toward the plants, though I don't know how the assembly will be fitted.

effect: The hooded lamp completes the sheltered garden setup by directing low-power light toward both troughs.
reaction: The image of the plants in a small pool of light is a satisfying close to the chapter.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the lettuce wick was most worthwhile because it showed how a bed can draw water while remaining drained enough for roots to get air.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making and then fitting the wick felt slightly repetitive, though the two steps explained how it worked.

surprise.text: I was interested that the deeper potato trough used a small pump while the shallow lettuce bed could use a wick.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each had a clear connection to watering or lighting the plants.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see how the station and its specimens fare after the storm.
